description: This file defines a decorator class 'OETestDepends' used for managing test case dependencies within the OEQA testing framework. It includes functions for adding dependencies, validating, ordering, and skipping tests based on dependencies, and integrates with unittest framework.

classes.name: OETestDepends
classes.description: A decorator class for managing test dependencies, inheriting from OETestDiscover, with methods to bind dependencies, discover test order, and set up dependency checks.

methods.name: bind
methods.description: Binds dependencies to a test case and updates the registry.

methods.name: discover
methods.description: Discovers and orders test cases based on dependencies from the registry.

methods.name: setUpDecorator
methods.description: Checks if dependent tests have passed or run before executing the test.
